column1: # AlphaFold 3 model parameters -- obtained by request from Google DeepMind
# under their Model Parameters Terms of Use. Non-commercial.
# These are the MODEL PARAMETERS only, ~1 GB. They are NOT the genetic
# databases, which are hundreds of GB, are fetched with upstream's
# fetch_databases.sh, and are not listed here because nobody should try to
# install them through a manifest. See README.md.
# The parameters bar commercial use of the OUTPUTS, not merely of the weights.
# For a therapeutic programme that restriction outlives the run, so record
# where any AF3-derived structure ends up.
